notes: Verdict: revise. The mechanism change is genuine. Drawn causal actions with endpoints replace labels, fills, cards and the absence diagram, and v4 retires announcement-scoped-absence-claim cleanly: no 'No station installed', no search ring finding nothing, and the limit is scoped to the announcement. It also now addresses story-contract-claim-binding (event 179) by listing every s9, s8 and registry rebind with baselines. Conditions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 are met. Three remain. Fixes needed for a pass: (1) remove the keep-skyline fallback, or replace it with another legal view that doesn't put 'open country' narration over the skyline; (2) drop the 'lifts the case upright … stands ready' beat. For example, fold the plan into the case pocket and close the case on the table with the deployment-goal tag, without implying an imminent field outing; (3) add s3, s4 and s7 board text to the editable scope or align the pictures with the unchanged text; (4) update plan r15c's repair and expected_visible_result to the v4 closing, the hub endpoint and the s5/s8/s9 plus registry scope; (5) fix the 'Bench and table' and 'phone-side hand-held tag' wording. On whether the curb table and carry case are invented: yes, they are invented props. No claim mentions a table, carry case, technician or outdoor packing. As a disclosed illustration of the stated goal (c10) a prop is acceptable, but the action must not picture readiness or departure for the field, which goes beyond c9 and the reported limits. A closed case left on the table, with no lift-and-go beat, would stay within the claims. Computed versus copied: I computed no hashes.
